digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC harness test oracle
propositions: The test asserts the raw Jira key (RBJNAZV-1) appears in the ticket JSON payload, but the actual local id is lowercased (jira-rbjnazv-1) and the raw key appears only as a title fallback when no summary exists.
The binding store holds the DC↔local correspondence separately from the ticket payload, but list_tickets does not return bindings, making a substring scan incapable of proving the round-trip.

The test assertion uses a case-sensitive substring scan of json.dumps(ticket) which cannot match the lowercased local id and fails to assert the binding that proves the ticket was created from the DC issue.

The provenance test must match on exact ticket id derived from _jira_key_to_local_id and additionally assert the binding store maps that id to the remote key to prove an issue created in DC appears in the local store.
